tests.recipe: Files: S3 T3.jsonl (s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl; base, plain, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0) and S3 r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl (s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl; base, plain, T 0.6 / top-p 0.95). In T3 keep the first row per problem_index in file order; in P_math500 keep, per problem_index, the row with the smallest sample value. Score each kept row with grader v3 (studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py) from text and gold, where an empty extraction counts 0. Self-opened = the first 60 characters of text contain the substring '\nOkay' (a newline immediately followed by 'Okay'). In each file separately, keep rows that are not self-opened, have cap_hit false and v3 score 0, and whose gold, after removing all '$' and whitespace and, if it is wholly wrapped in \boxed{...}, taking the inside, fully matches ^-?\d+$ with absolute value >= 10. For each kept row, let t = text with every comma between digits deleted (regex (?<=\d),(?=\d) replaced by ''). Let g = the digits of the gold's absolute value, written without leading zeros. The row is a hit if the regex (?<![0-9])g(?![0-9]) matches anywhere in t. F(file) = hits / kept rows. Statistic: F(T3) - F(P_math500). If either file has no kept rows, report nothing.
tests.note: Files: T3 = s3://.../rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl and P = s3://.../rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl, fetched under runs/theory-tests/s3k/rlneurons/ (500 rows each, one per problem, so the first-row and smallest-sample rules have no effect). v3 is regraded from text and gold with rln4_lib.grade_v3 (P_math500 stores only v1). Self-opened = a real newline followed by 'Okay' within text[:60] (I read the JSON '\\nOkay' as the newline character, per the recipe's parenthesis). Filters, applied per file: not self-opened, cap_hit is False, v3 == 0, gold (with '$' and whitespace removed, a whole \\boxed{...} unwrapped only when the brace opened after \\boxed closes at the last character) fully matching ^-?\\d+$ with |gold| >= 10. g = str(abs(int(gold))), so leading zeros are dropped. Hit = (?<![0-9])g(?![0-9]) found in the text with commas between digits removed; this also matches the gold inside the problem restatement, intermediate work or a wrong boxed value such as -g, so it is a loose gold-in-text test. Rows with empty text (some rows have n_new 0, finish_reason stop) pass cap_hit false and v3 0 and count as non-hits in the main number; alt_measured drops empty-text rows from both files, reading 'finished answers' as answers that were actually generated. Interval: paired bootstrap over problems that have a kept row in at least one file (entry = (T3 classification or None, P classification or None)); F is recomputed per file in each resample; a resample with no kept row in one file gives 0.0. n = number of such problems, not the sum of kept rows in both files. No kept rows in a file prints not_computable.
